content:
Devin has four self-serve plans you can sign up for directly at [app.devin.ai](https://app.devin.ai). For authoritative pricing, see the [Devin pricing page](https://devin.ai/pricing). This page explains how the plans relate to each other and how billing mechanics work.

## Plan overview

| Plan | For | Price | Members |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | Individuals trying Devin | Free | 1 |
| **Pro** | Individual users | $20/month | 1 |
| **Max** | Power users who need more quota | $200/month | 1 |
| **Teams** | Teams working with Devin together | $80/month | Multiple |

The **Pro** and **Max** plans are individual plans. They cannot be shared across multiple users. If you want multiple people to use Devin under a single subscription, you need the **Teams** plan.

The [Jira](/integrations/jira) and [Microsoft Teams](/integrations/microsoft-teams) integrations are available on [Enterprise](/admin/billing/enterprise) only. To add them, [contact sales](https://cognition.com/contact).

## Free

The Free plan lets you try Devin with limited usage. It includes:

- Limited Devin usage
- Access to [Devin Review](/work-with-devin/devin-review)
- Access to [DeepWiki](/work-with-devin/deepwiki)

Free users can upgrade to any paid plan at any time from [Settings > Plans](https://app.devin.ai/settings/plans).

## Pro

Pro is Devin’s entry-level individual plan. It’s designed for a single developer who uses Devin regularly. Pro includes:

- A daily and weekly usage quota that covers Devin sessions, [Devin CLI](/cli), and [Devin Desktop](https://windsurf.com)
- Pay-as-you-go on-demand credits for usage past your quota
- Slack, Linear, and [MCP](/work-with-devin/mcp) integrations

Pro is a single-user plan. Pro subscribers cannot invite additional members to their organization. To work with teammates on a shared subscription, use the Teams plan.

## Max

Max is for individual users who consistently exceed the Pro quota. It includes everything in Pro, plus a significantly larger weekly usage quota (with no daily cap), also shared between Devin sessions, [Devin CLI](/cli), and Devin Desktop. Like Pro, Max is a single-user plan and does not support multiple members.

## Teams

The Teams plan is Devin’s self-serve plan for teams working with Devin together. Key properties:

- **$80/month**: every Teams subscription is a flat $80/month, charged as prepaid on-demand credits.
- **On-demand credits** are shared across the whole team. Every member draws from the same pool, and admins can top up at any time.
- Every member gets the same access to Devin cloud sessions, [Devin CLI](/cli), and Devin Desktop.
- **SAML or OIDC single sign-on** for your team account. See SSO for Teams.
- **Cost controls with 3 usage tiers** to cap how much each member can use. See Cost controls.
- **Free mode**: each member can run up to 2 cloud sessions at a time at no cost. See Free mode.

Larger teams that need more controls should [contact sales](https://cognition.com/contact) about Enterprise.

### SSO

Teams admins can connect a SAML 2.0 or OIDC identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or any compliant IdP) from [Settings > Authentication](https://app.devin.ai/settings/authentication). On a Teams account, SSO signs in existing members only, so invite people before they sign in through SSO. Follow the identity provider setup steps in the [SSO onboarding guide](/enterprise/security-access/sso/guide); its auto-membership, role assignment, and SCIM provisioning steps apply to [Enterprise](/admin/billing/enterprise) only.

### Cost controls

Teams admins can cap each member’s usage with up to **3 usage tiers** from [Settings > Usage policies](https://app.devin.ai/settings/usage-policies). Each tier sets a usage limit, members are assigned to a tier or fall back to the default tier, and new work is blocked once a member reaches their limit. The [usage tiers](/enterprise/features/usage-policies#usage-tiers) section of the Usage policies guide explains how tiers work; budgets and budget-scoped limits apply to Enterprise only.

### Free mode

On the Teams plan, every member can pick **Free (powered by SWE-2)** in the agent selector to run Devin cloud sessions at no cost. Each member can run up to **2 Free sessions at a time**; to start a third, wait for one to finish or pick another mode. Sessions in other modes are billed as usual.

## How quotas work

Pro and Max include a usage allowance that refreshes automatically on a calendar basis:

- **Pro** has a **daily and weekly** allowance. The daily allowance is more than 1/7 of the weekly, so you can keep working through weekends without giving up overall capacity for the week.
- **Max** has a **weekly** allowance only, with no daily cap.
- **Teams** has no per-member allowance: all usage draws from the team’s shared on-demand credits.

When you’ve used up your allowance, on-demand credits keep you working without interruption. If your on-demand balance is also empty, sessions pause until your allowance refreshes or you purchase more credits. If you have an eligible ChatGPT Go, Plus, or Pro subscription, you can also [use your ChatGPT plan](/admin/billing/chatgpt) to pay for GPT model usage so it doesn’t count against your Devin allowance.

## On-demand credits

On-demand credits are prepaid usage credit that fund any work past your plan’s included quota:

- **Roll over** month-to-month. Purchased credits never expire.
- Can be topped up at any time: select **Purchase on-demand usage** on the current plan card in [Settings > Plans](https://app.devin.ai/settings/plans) or [Settings > Usage & limits](https://app.devin.ai/settings/usage). Select **Configure auto-reload settings** next to it to refill credits automatically.
- Admins can set auto-reload thresholds and default session spending limits from [Settings > Usage & limits](https://app.devin.ai/settings/usage).
- On the **Teams** plan, credits are **shared across all members**, with no per-member balance. Any teammate can draw from the shared pool.
- On the **Teams** plan, credits fund all usage, and the $80/month subscription is added to the pool as credits each month.

## Devin Review and Automations Pricing

[Automations](/product-guides/automations) and [Devin Review](/work-with-devin/devin-review) are available on self-serve plans.

- **Teams use shared on-demand credits.** On the Teams plan, Automations and Devin Review draw directly from the team’s shared on-demand credit pool.
- **What happens when you run out of credits.** If you run out of credits, Automations stop running and Devin Review switches to its diff viewer. Top up on-demand credits to start Automations again and re-enable AI-powered review.
- **Public PRs are free.** Anyone can review a public GitHub PR at [devinreview.com](https://devinreview.com) — or by replacing `github.com` with `devinreview.com` in any PR URL — without a Devin account, and no on-demand credits are consumed.

Review managers can keep usage predictable with auto-review rules in [Settings > Review](https://app.devin.ai/settings/review). Choose when a rule starts (**PR is created** or **PR is ready**) and its cadence (**Only once** or **Every push**), then narrow its scope with repository or author conditions. See [Trigger Modes](/work-with-devin/devin-review#trigger-modes) in the Devin Review docs for details.

## Managing your plan

Admins can view and change the account’s plan from [Settings > Plans](https://app.devin.ai/settings/plans). From there you can:

- Upgrade or downgrade between Free, Pro, Max, and Teams with the button on each plan’s card: **Purchase** from the Free plan, **Upgrade** or **Downgrade** from a paid plan. To cancel a paid plan, select **Downgrade** on the Free card.
- Purchase on-demand credits or configure auto-reload to replenish them automatically

Past invoices are available to download from [Settings > Invoices](https://app.devin.ai/settings/invoices). For accepted payment methods and how to update your billing details, see [Plans and Usage](/desktop/accounts/usage). For tips on keeping consumption under control across all plans, see [Usage](/admin/billing/usage).
